sloka: इति रामेण सा प्रोक्ता राक्षसी काम मोहिता ।विसृज्य रामम् सहसा ततो लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-१८-६॥
transliteration: iti rāmeṇa sā proktā rākṣasī kāma mohitā ।visṛjya rāmam sahasā tato lakṣmaṇam abravīt ॥3-18-6॥

translations.english: Thus told by Rama, the demoness, deluded with lust, left him suddenly, and said to Lakshmana:
